_doc: E8 inpaint bench (04 §6). Source = the E0 fp8 20-step render of t2i/01 (seed 20261004), 960x544. Masks are generated by make_masks.py from the boxes below (white = repaint). Tasks needing a subject matte take their mask from BiRefNet at run time. Scores: seam visibility, colour match, identity preservation, prompt adherence, time.

tasks.prompt: empty rain-soaked alley floor of wet cobblestones and a grimy brick wall with a steaming vent, no crates
tasks.expect: crates gone, cobblestone pattern and wall texture continue seamlessly, reflections consistent

tasks.prompt: a dark red oiled leather jacket with a hood, wet with rain, same young woman, same pose, holding the brass compass
tasks.expect: garment changes colour and material, face, hair, hand and compass unchanged, edges clean

tasks.prompt: a sunlit cobbled harbour square at noon, white-washed houses, blue sky, fishing boats, same young woman unchanged
tasks.expect: subject preserved pixel-for-pixel, new background with plausible lighting on the subject edges

tasks.prompt: the alley continues to the right: more wet cobblestones, a doorway with a lit window, rain
tasks.expect: no visible seam at x=960, perspective and lighting continue, no duplicated subject

tasks.prompt: the same young woman's face, freckles, calm expression, looking at the viewer, natural eyes, same lighting
tasks.expect: identity kept (freckles, hair line, skin tone), eyes corrected, no change outside the box
